summary: Pakistani organizations should immediately prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-20349 and CVE-2026-68820, which are being actively exploited and have been added to the CISA KEV catalog, and are also being exploited as zero-day exploits, affecting multiple vendors including Microsoft and Google. The Pakistan CERT/NCCS has also issued alerts for PKCERT-917CDA37 and PKCERT-78CA5DA2, which are specific to the Pakistani region and require immediate attention from local organizations to prevent potential attacks. To mitigate these threats, Pakistani organizations should focus on applying patches for CVE-2026-72898, CVE-2026-8037, and CVE-2026-63077, and follow the guidelines provided by the Pakistan CERT/NCCS to ensure the security of their systems and networks.
